positive: An eligible account receives one bounded daily interest credit.
The credit has exactly one authoritative bank-ledger entry.
negative: A same-day replay does not credit again or append another ledger entry.
Below-minimum or frozen accounts remain unchanged.
A ledger failure rolls back the balance and ledger mutation.
persistence: Balance and ledger readbacks agree before and after restart.
Concurrent scheduler invocations settle at most once for the day.
evidence: Each command records response and event batch.
Each command records authoritative state and read-only database snapshots before and after.

dependency_note: Do not execute against a live server until CODEX 2/3 select and wire one authoritative scheduler path and QA-INT-01 permits disposable bootstrap.
